_purpose: Calibration fixtures for periodic quality review. Each fixture is a song with: a natural user query, the tradition framing the codex should be invoked with, a gold-standard structural blueprint written in codex output format (descriptor-only, no proper nouns, no specific gear models), and key descriptors that MUST appear in valid output. Run via scripts/calibrate.js. Treat discrepancies via the four-bin taxonomy in SKILL.md (catalog issue / algorithm issue / genuine ambiguity / curator misconception).
_curation_principles: Songs the curator knows cold (not Wikipedia-derived) so the gold-standard is reliable
One per major tradition cluster — variety over coverage
Mix solo and ensemble, mix pure and fusion
Gold-standards follow codex output rules exactly: no artist/band/producer/studio names, no specific gear models, descriptor-level only, structural blueprint not session log

Gold-standards describe the TRADITION'S CENTRAL TENDENCY, not the specific track's anomalies (Dylan's track has no harmonica but delta_blues canonically does — the gold-standard reflects the tradition)
Key descriptors use catalog vocabulary (verified by running recipe.js on the tradition first), not the curator's preferred phrasing

Renamed qawwal_voice variants from qawwal_lead/chorus to qawwali_lead/chorus (so 'qawwali' becomes a token in the variant id, making qawwali-canonical iconic). Enriched descriptors with melismatic, ornate, sustained-high-register, declaimed, etc. Added melismatic, ornate, declaimed, lament-wail to TRUSTED_TECHNIQUE_DESCRIPTORS in translate.js as generic vocal techniques.

Added new fado_voice variant to voice_quality with descriptors [lament-wail, melismatic, ornate, saudade, fado-canonical]. Reordered so lament-wail is first (the surfacing iconic). Generic vocal-technique whitelist additions (see qawwali fix) also apply.

Trimmed hindustani.instruments to canonical trio [sitar, tabla, tanpura]. Added new hindustani_sarod tradition for the second-most-canonical instrumental hindustani style with [sarod, tabla, tanpura]. Description updated to match the trimmed scope. Note: dilruba, esraj, rudra_veena, santoor are now temporarily orphaned in the catalog; sub-traditions for these should be added in future editorial work.

Added 7 calibration fixtures locking in: chain mechanism (transformer-coupled / optical / Pultec / autotune), warm-audit instrument-side wins (low-mid-rich-spectrum on archtop), vibes-audit wins (overtone-rich-sustained), voice_isolated fixes (britfolk_revival incomplete_closure), Phase 1 voice mechanism (cool_jazz aspirated). fixtures.user_query: Bob Dylan — In My Time of Dyin' (1962 debut album)
fixtures.framing_note: Folk-revivalist channeling pre-war delta blues; primary tradition is the apparatus context, secondary is the channeled aesthetic. Track is a solo simplification of an inherently multi-instrument tradition. Voice/technique update post-subtoken-dedup: Dylan's actual delivery is folk-revival fingerpicked + worn-fold-rasp (channeling Johnson), not slide-canonical pure delta. The fingerpicked rendering reflects the apparatus correctly. Bin-4 note (SKILL.md discrepancy taxonomy): the worn-fold-rasp aesthetic from delta as half-weight staple is structurally outweighed by greenwich-primary's incomplete-closure pull (folk-revival/confessional/singer-songwriter context tokens). The catalog's blend semantics is primary-dominant for voice; surfacing both fingerpicked-apparatus AND delta-aesthetic-voice from a primary+staple blend would require track-specific 'apparatus-from-primary, aesthetic-from-secondary' semantics that the catalog does not implement. Key-descriptor 'worn fold' dropped; fingerpicked + parlor remain the testable quality signals.
fixtures.gold_standard: classic 1960s greenwich village confessional folk, ballad Poetry, 60s confessional delta blues. thick, incomplete closure resting, melodic, narrative. fingerpicked acoustic guitar, straight folk harmonica, fingerpicked steel resonator guitar. parlor. large-diaphragm condenser, tube pre, colored vintage console. analog tape.
